a: C. T. Studd (1860–1931) yali muzannyi wa cricket owa Bungereza, eyagaba obugagga oluvannyuma lw’okukyuka kwe ne yeegatta ku "Cambridge Seven" ng’omuminsani — ng’aweereza e China, e Buyindi, era ku nkomerero mu Kongo, gye yatandikira ekyafuuka WEC. Omusajja ow’obunyiikivu obw’amaanyi, obutakkiriza kukkakkana, era oluusi obuzibu, yawangaala ng’agoberera okukkiriza nti tewali ssaddaaka esobola kuba nnene nnyo ku lwa Kristo. Yali omu ku bazannyi abasinga obulungi Bungereza be yalina abaali basobola buli kitundu ky’omuzannyo, era mu myaka esatu oluvannyuma lw’okuzannya mu Test eyawa cricket "the Ashes" yali alese omuzannyo n’agenda e China.

Yazaalibwa nga 2 Desemba 1860 e Spratton, Northamptonshire, mu maka ag’obugagga — kitaawe yali nnannyini nnimiro ennene eyawummula, eyali afunye obugagga obungi e Buyindi. Charles yasomera ku Eton, gye yakulembera ttiimu ya cricket ey’abazannyi kkumi n’omu ng’aweza emyaka kkumi na mwenda, n’oluvannyuma mu Trinity College, Cambridge, n’afuuka emmunyeenye y’omuzannyo gwa yunivasite. Enkyukakyuka yajjira mu kitaawe, eyakyuka mu 1877 mu kaweefube wa Moody ne Sankey, n’akubiriza batabani be okukkiriza enjiri; mu 1878, ng’aweza emyaka kkumi na munaana, Charles naye yakyuka.

Nedda — era yali mwesimbu ku bbanga eryo. Okumala emyaka nga mukaaga, nga bwe yannyonnyola oluvannyuma ye kennyini, yali Mukristaayo mu linnya kyokka, naye mu bikolwa ng’ali mu bunnyogovu, okukkiriza kwe nga kintu kya kyama ekyakyusa kitono era ekyamufiiriza kitono n’okusingawo; cricket yali akyali bulamu bwe. Kitundu kya mugaso mu mboozi ye: okukyuka kwali tekunnafuuka kwewaayo, era enjawulo eyo yagitegeera oluvannyuma lwokka. Ekyamenya obunnyogovu obwo bwali bulwadde obw’amaanyi obwa muganda we George mu 1884, obwamuleetera okwebuuza ettutumu lye lyonna kye lyali ligasa singa omuntu asobola okuggwaawo amangu bwe gatyo, n’okuwulira nate D. L. Moody ng’abuulira.

Mu 1885 Studd yasaabala okugenda e China ne China Inland Mission eya Hudson Taylor, era teyagenda yekka: abavubuka abalala mukaaga ab’e Cambridge abaali mu mbeera ennungi baagenda naye — abazannyi, omuserikale omukulu, abasajja abaalina ebiseera eby’omu maaso ebitangaavu — era ekibinja ekyo ne kimanyika mu Bungereza yonna nga Cambridge Seven. Okugenda kwabwe kwalangirirwa mu bugenderevu okuzuukusa omuntu ow’omunda ow’eggwanga ku by’obuminsani, era kwakola: nti abasajja musanvu abaali basobola okufuna buli kimu Bungereza kye yali ewa baali bakireka olwa China, kyali kyewuunyo kinene.

Bwe yafuna obusika bwe, kumpi bwonna yabugaba — omuwendo ogwogerwako mu ngeri ez’enjawulo nga pawundi emitwalo ebiri mu enkumi ttaano okutuuka ku mitwalo ebiri mu enkumi mwenda, obugagga obungi ennyo mu kiseera ekyo — ng’aweereza ebirabo ebinene eri omulimu gwa Moody e Chicago, amaka g’abaana bamulekwa aga George Müller, obuminsani e Whitechapel, Eggye ery’Obulokozi e Buyindi, n’ebigendererwa ebirala. Yakuumayo omuwendo omutono ku lwa mukazi we ow’omu maaso; emboozi esinga okuddibwamu egamba nti mukazi oyo yamugamba naye ogwo agugabe, balyoke batandike obufumbo nga tebalina kye beesiga okuggyako Katonda.

Sentensi emu ye kisumuluzo ky’ebyo byonna bye yakola n’ebyo byonna bye yakola obubi: "Singa Yesu Kristo ye Katonda era yanfiirira, kale tewali ssaddaaka esobola kuba nnene nnyo nze okugiwaayo ku Lulwe." Yagikkiriza awatali kukakkanya kwonna, era teyayiga kuleka bantu balala kugikkiriza mu mbiro zaabwe ez’enjawulo. Era yawandiika ennyiriri ezisinga okugattibwa ku linnya lye: "Abamu baagala okubeera we bawulira eddoboozi ly’endege y’ekkanisa oba ey’essinzizo; nze njagala okuddukanya ekifo eky’okununuliramu emyoyo mu yaadi emu okuva ku ggeyeena."

q: Mulimu ki gwe yakola e China ne Buyindi?
a: Yamala emyaka nga kkumi e China, n’awasa omuminsani Priscilla Livingstone Stewart mu 1888, era n’akolera munda mu nsi mu mbeera ennyangu era enzibu China Inland Mission gye yasuubiranga. Obulamu bwe bwaggwaamu amaanyi wansi w’akazito ke yabuteekangako, era mu 1894 obulwadde bwawaliriza amaka okuddayo e Bungereza. Olw’okuba teyatondebwa kuwummula, yatwala obusumba e Ootacamund mu nsozi z’obukiikaddyo bwa Buyindi okuva nga mu 1900 okutuuka mu 1906, mu batuuze aboogera Olungereza n’abaserikale — omulimu ogw’akasirise okusinga ogw’e China, era nga si gwe omutima gwe gwe gwali gwegomba.

Ekyamukwata kwali Afirika eya wakati — ebitundu ebinene bye yakkiriza nti tebyali biwulirangako njiri. Yali asussa emyaka ataano, obulamu bwe bwali bubi, era abasawo baamugamba lwatu nti tasaana kugenda. Wabula yagenda, ng’awaayo eri Katonda ekintu ekisembayo kye yali asigazza, emyaka gy’omusajja omukadde era omulwadde. Mu 1913 yatandikawo Heart of Africa Mission n’asitula okugenda mu Kongo ey’Ababirigi; omulimu gwakula ne gufuuka Worldwide Evangelisation Crusade (WEC), era yamalayo emyaka nga kkumi na munaana, ku nkomerero ng’abeera e Ibambi, ng’abuulira era ng’asimba amakanisa.

Nedda — era obwesimbu bwetaaga omuwendo ogwo gwogerwe. Obukakanyavu obwo bwennyini obwamuleetera okugaba buli kimu bwamufuula muzibu nnyo okukola naye. Emyaka gye mu Kongo gyajjula obukuubagano — ne baminsani banne, n’ab’omu maka ge, era mu bulumi, n’omwami wa muwala we yennyini Alfred Buxton; abo abataasobola kwenkana bukambwe bwe baaleetebwa okuwulira nti baali balemeddwa, era mu myaka gye egy’enkomerero akakiiko ak’ewaka kaakola okumuggya ku mulimu gwe yali atandiseewo. Ng’akooyeddwa obulwadde, yeekuuma mu kwefiiriza okukambwe era n’akozesa mofiini olw’okubonaabona kwe. Yali muzira, naye era mukakanyavu, era ku nkomerero, mu kigero ekimu, yamenyebwa obukambwe bwe ye kennyini.

Yafiira e Ibambi nga 16 Julaayi 1931, ng’aweza emyaka nsanvu, olw’amayinja mu nsawo y’omususa agataajjanjabwa, ng’agaana okutuusa ku nkomerero obujjanjabi omubiri gwe bwe gwali gwetaaga; ennono ejjukira ekigambo kye ekisembayo nga "Haleluya." Mu nnyiriri ze yayagalanga n’aweereza bazzukulu be mu bbaluwa ey’okusiibula mwalimu bino: "Obulamu bumu bwokka, bujja kuyita mangu; ekyo kyokka ekikolebwa ku lwa Kristo kye kirisigala." Yaleka obuminsani obw’ensi yonna obukyatwala enjiri kumpi kyasa kimu oluvannyuma, n’obulamu obwasukkiriza ennyo ne kiba nti abamwagala n’abamunenya tebakkiriziganyanga ddala ku ngeri y’okubutwalamu — ow’ekitiibwa ekingi ate nga takwatika mu biseera eby’enjawulo. Yali amaze okugonjoola ekibuuzo kyokka ekyamukwatako ng’aweza emyaka kkumi na munaana, era tewali na kimu ku byo kye yabala nga ssaddaaka.
